title: Before the sevilla heat, enjoy a cool guided run!
text:
I met my friendly, informative guide Idalino at 7:00 am a 2 minute walk from my hotel. It was hot arriving in Sevilla the previous afternoon, about 35 degrees C (96 F) and the same afternoon temps, were expected our running day.

However, our run began at 15.5 C (about 60 F). It was wonderfully pleasant. We saw and discussed many historically important sites & cultural influences including Roman Jewish, Muslim, and Christian. We ran different neighborhoods and along the river. I loved every minute.

author: PADDY O

title: A wonderful Experience - best way to see the city
text:
A huge thank you to Michael and Idalino, who organised and guided my wife and I around the city.

My wife is marathon training and I am fit but don’t run often. We found the perfect pace to converse and allow Idalino the opportunity to tell us about the great sites to Sevilla. Such a beautiful city, and exploring it over an 11km run at 8.30 am was perfect for us.

Highly recommended for active people wanting to do something fun and different. 

This made my wife’s 49th birthday very special and is the highlight of our trip. 

Many thanks again, a truly brilliant activity
author: Tom_J

title: Perfect Morning Run
text: Awesome running with Mike! The route was seamless, chosen to avoid over crowded areas and paths.  It wasn't my first time in Sevilla, but I really enjoyed seeing the city this way. Mike was punctual, focused, and made great conversation, sharing cool insights about the city, restaurant tips, and life here, without being overly talkative. He's a solid running partner who matched my pace but also knew when to push me a bit. A great way to start the day. Will use Run Sevilla again.
author: slomad2017

title: Such a great way to see Seville!
text:
We love the running tour concept anyway, as a great way to orientate yourself in a city and to cover a lot of ground in a short time, but we particularly loved running with Mike who is so clearly passionate about his adopted hometown, and running. It's such a great way to see the city of Seville and its plethora of beautiful sights, especially in the peaceful morning time before many tourists gather (and the heat rises!) - it felt almost like a secret way to see the city.
 A really really great run out, with Mike adapting to any needs/paces/wishes of how you would like to run the tour. Keep go
author: hannahdF6639WN

title: Best way to discover Seville!
text: This running tour is a great way to see Sevilla while making a local friend. Mike is kind, friendly, and knowledgeable about the city. In addition to learning interesting facts about the essential sights, I was inspired by Mike's passion for running. He was accommodating of my pace and shared many useful running tips. It was a fun way to get situated in a new city.
author: Q1074ZMrahulg

title: Great tour - wonderful guide and experience
text: Mike was an amazing tour guide and as I’m training for the London marathon, this was a great way to keep up the training while seeing a new city. I love the concept and was able to see so much of this beautiful city by foot in a short time. I’d highly recommend this tour, even if you’re not training, and just want to see the city with an experienced, native English speaking tour guide!
author: L1342NXtinah

title: A unique perspective of Sevilla  in running shoes
text: I have been coming to Sevilla for the past 15 years. Today I took a 7 mile running tour with Run Sevilla. My guide, Mike is an excellent runner and was able to run at my snails pace. We stopped frequently because I am such a poor runner and he was able to tell me all of the sites several of these places, I have never seen before. hi! highly recommend this tour for anyone who wants to run Sevilla and see a unique perspective of the city I also believe any level of runner will enjoy this experience
author: TheLASIKDoc

title: Fun (& Fit) way to see the City!
text:
This is such an incredible way to see the city. This was our third time to Seville and we wanted to try something new. My husband and I are new runners, and Michael did a fantastic job catering the tour to our skillset as well as our interests. 

He is extremely knowledgable about the city, and keeps the tour engaging and fun. He also had great tips for must-see places, even those off the beaten path. Highly Recommend.
